info.name: Get an evacuation plan map of a location

params.name: locationId
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the location to return the details for.

items.docs:
Returns evacuation plan map attachments details for the specified location.
Visit ServiceChannel University to learn about [Location Emergency Evacuation Plan Map(s)](https://servicechannel.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SCU/pages/710312376/Location+Emergency+Evacuation+Plan+Map+s).

info.name: Check whether the location is open or closed.

params.name: locationId
params.description: Unique location identifier

params.name: checkTime
params.description: Date and time to check if the location is open

items.docs:
Returns information on the specified location if it is open or closed now. If the `checkTime` parameter is not provided, the location is checked at the current time.
Learn about [managing business hours](https://servicechannel.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SCU/pages/683507788/Managing+Business+Hours) in ServiceChannel University.

Returns locations based on the filters applied.
             By default closed locations are not included in the response. To include them, set the `IncludeClosedLocations` parameter to `true`.

info.name: Create a location with location notes

items.docs:
Create or update a location along with location notes.
**Note:** Method takes a dynamic list of parameters as input.

Returns a list of stores with the LocationIDs and StoreIds, along with the first contract (assignment) created date and whether the location is primary or not.
The method is available to providers only.
